configurations.name: Hero quote or image
configurations.source: Global Home presentation: default shows the quote tool when the effective Site has rates and quoting enabled, otherwise the hero image. A Site may select hero-image even when rates are available. requirements/global/configuration-bindings.json; runtime supported

configurations.name: Show entry notice before starting
configurations.source: Global optional Home entry notice. Effective Sites select home.landing-notice content and enable this setting; Cancel stays on Home and Continue starts the application. ASCE inherits disabled.

configurations.name: Single-page decorative artwork
configurations.source: Existing shared Home/single-page decorative scene; src/config/homepagePresentation.ts. Global definition/default, optional effective-Site assignment. ASCE inherits none; source transfer does not approve new artwork behavior.
